verdict.rationale: Plymouth Street is an immigration-services provider with status dashboards and People Ops integration, so an API is a fair question. The evidence never documents a public API, and probes for an OpenAPI spec and llms.txt all returned 404. The vague claim that it will "plug into your People Ops" is an adjacent integration claim, not documented API parity with the UI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
